newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe says French peoples' mood improving.
newsitem.headline: Juppe says French peoples' mood improving.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Monday the mood of French citizens was improving and the country was going in the right direction.

"Everyone says there's an upturn. Now, how long will it last, how deep it is, I don't know, and we are going to do everything we can to increase it...but without question we can see everywhere that for the last month or two things have been going in a more favourable direction," Juppe said during a radio interview.
